title: 雅萬高速鐵路~Jakarta–Bandung high-speed railway
focus: 熱帶新建高速線橋隧與接駁系統~Tropical new high speed bridges tunnels and feeder service
summary: 以雅加達至萬隆高速鐵路為背景，建立熱帶丘陵中的橋隧連續路線及接駁旅程。學徒從降雨、坡度和曲線開始，延伸到車站轉乘與需求批次到達，要求把列車行車時間和門到門旅程時間分別驗證。~Use the Jakarta–Bandung high-speed railway to construct a tropical hillside route with successive bridges, tunnels and feeder journeys. Begin with rainfall, gradients and curves, then extend the analysis to station interchange and batch arrivals. Verify train running time separately from door-to-door journey time so that fast line-haul service is not mistaken for a complete passenger-experience result.
example: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 deflection=1.103997 mm；單元 2 得 gradient=0.63 mm/m；單元 3 得 flow=0.3213 m^3/s。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 L 的擾動測試，結果改為 1.616362 mm；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以雅加達至萬隆高速鐵路為背景，建立熱帶丘陵中的橋隧連續路線及接駁旅程。學徒從降雨、坡度和曲線開始，延伸到車站轉乘與需求批次到達，要求把列車行車時間和門到門旅程時間分別驗證。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。~Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives deflection=1.103997 mm; unit 2 gives gradient=0.63 mm/m; unit 3 gives flow=0.3213 m^3/s. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing L in the first unit changes its result to 1.616362 mm. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use the Jakarta–Bandung high-speed railway to construct a tropical hillside route with successive bridges, tunnels and feeder journeys. Begin with rainfall, gradients and curves, then extend the analysis to station interchange and batch arrivals. Verify train running time separately from door-to-door journey time so that fast line-haul service is not mistaken for a complete passenger-experience result. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
history: 公開工程與出版時間線：2023 年：雅萬高速鐵路於十月舉行啟用並開始付費服務；2024 年：營運者發布服務累計旅客與旅遊連結回顧。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以雅加達至萬隆高速鐵路為背景，建立熱帶丘陵中的橋隧連續路線及接駁旅程。學徒從降雨、坡度和曲線開始，延伸到車站轉乘與需求批次到達，要求把列車行車時間和門到門旅程時間分別驗證。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。~Public engineering and publication chronology: 2023: Jakarta–Bandung high-speed rail was inaugurated and began paid service in October; 2024: The operator published a review of accumulated ridership and tourism connections. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the Jakarta–Bandung high-speed railway to construct a tropical hillside route with successive bridges, tunnels and feeder journeys. Begin with rainfall, gradients and curves, then extend the analysis to station interchange and batch arrivals. Verify train running time separately from door-to-door journey time so that fast line-haul service is not mistaken for a complete passenger-experience result. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

units.anchor: 橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度~Bridge deflection and span sensitivity
units.title: 橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度~Bridge deflection and span sensitivity
units.mechanism: 簡支梁在均布荷載下的撓度對跨長有四次方敏感度，截面慣性矩與材料剛度共同抵抗彎曲。鐵道橋還需要動態與軌道相互作用檢查，靜態梁算例只用來辨認參數量級。 跨長四次方使幾何誤差特別重要，但只有在相同支承、均布荷載及截面條件下才可比較。將毫米轉成公尺後再核對剛度，可避免把量測位移誤差變成材料性能判斷。 在高架橋量測跨中及支點位移，區分彎曲與基礎移動。~For a simply supported beam under uniform load, deflection scales with the fourth power of span. Section inertia and material stiffness jointly resist bending. A railway bridge also requires dynamic and track-interaction checks; this static beam exercise only reveals parameter magnitudes. Fourth-power span dependence makes geometry important, but comparison requires the same support, uniform-load and section assumptions. Convert millimetres and metres consistently before checking stiffness, so a displacement-unit error does not become a false conclusion about material properties. Measure viaduct midspan and support displacement to distinguish bending from foundation movement.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：w=50000 N/m; L=26.25 m; E=3.5e+10 Pa; I=8 m^4；計算：deflection=5*w*L**4/(384*E*I)*1000=1.103997 mm。敏感度：L 單獨增加百分之十至 28.875 m，其餘固定，結果為 1.616362 mm。模型邊界：簡支Euler梁、小撓度、靜態均布荷載；不代表列車移動荷載。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: w=50000 N/m; L=26.25 m; E=3.5e+10 Pa; I=8 m^4; calculation: deflection=5*w*L**4/(384*E*I)*1000=1.103997 mm. Sensitivity: L, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 28.875 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.616362 mm. Model boundary: Simply supported Euler beam, small deflection and static uniform load; not a moving train-load analysis.
units.verify: 在已知載重位置量測跨中和支點位移，扣除支承沉陷後對照彎矩圖，並用卸載後讀值檢查是否存在殘留變形。 先以已知荷載校對位移計量程與零點，分別記錄載入卸載路徑及支點運動。~Measure midspan and support movement under known loading, subtract support settlement, compare with the moment diagram, and inspect residual displacement after unloading. Check displacement-sensor range and zero under known loading, recording loading and unloading paths separately from support movement.
units.failure: 支承鬆動或局部開裂可能改變有效剛度，若把所有位移都當成梁彎曲，校準出的彈性模數就會失真。 若卸載後仍有位移，須區分基座滑移與構件殘留變形。~Loose supports and local cracking alter effective stiffness; interpreting all displacement as beam bending produces a misleading calibrated elastic modulus. Residual displacement after unloading requires distinguishing fixture slip from permanent structural deformation.
units.misconception: 橋梁跨長增加一成其彈性撓度最多只增加一成~Increasing bridge span by ten percent increases elastic deflection by at most ten percent.
units.practice: 保持截面不變增加跨長，再比較提高慣性矩的補償幅度，說明靜態位移符合預期為何仍不能取代動態驗證。 再以本單元 L 的對照值重算 deflection，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Increase span while keeping the section fixed, calculate the compensating inertia change, and explain why agreement in static deflection cannot replace dynamic verification. Also recalculate deflection for the alternative L value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 沉陷差與軌道坡折~Differential settlement and track kink
units.title: 沉陷差與軌道坡折~Differential settlement and track kink
units.mechanism: 均勻沉陷主要改變高程，短距離差異沉陷則改變軌道坡度和車輪動態荷載。兩端高差除以基長只給平均坡度，無法描述局部尖峰；需要多點剖面才能辨認曲率與變形長度。 相同端點坡度可以對應完全不同的中間形狀，因此坡度不能單獨表示軌道曲率。測點間距必須小於欲辨認的變形尺度，並將高程誤差相對於基長傳遞到坡度結果。 追蹤橋台與填土路基之間的差異沉陷長度尺度。~Uniform settlement mainly changes elevation, whereas differential settlement over a short distance alters track slope and dynamic wheel loading. End-to-end difference divided by baseline gives only an average gradient, not a local peak. A spatial profile is needed to identify curvature and deformation length. Identical endpoint gradient can hide very different intermediate shapes, so gradient alone cannot describe track curvature. Survey spacing must resolve the deformation length scale, and elevation uncertainty must be propagated relative to the baseline into the reported gradient. Track the length scale of differential settlement between an abutment and filled earthworks.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：drop=0.0126 m; baseline=20 m；計算：gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.63 mm/m。敏感度：drop 單獨增加百分之十至 0.01386 m，其餘固定，結果為 0.693 mm/m。模型邊界：小變形平均坡度；不計車軌耦合動力或容許軌道幾何。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: drop=0.0126 m; baseline=20 m; calculation: gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.63 mm/m. Sensitivity: drop, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.01386 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.693 mm/m. Model boundary: Small-deformation average gradient; vehicle-track dynamics and permissible geometry limits are excluded.
units.verify: 採用同一穩定水準基點反覆量測，保留溫度和施工時間，利用多點高程剖面區分整段平移、坡折與量測基點漂移。 重複觀測同一測點並做閉合檢核，以另一穩定基準核對零點，報告高差與基長各自誤差。~Repeat surveys against one stable datum, retain temperature and construction timing, and use multipoint profiles to separate translation, kinks and datum drift. Repeat identical points with closure checks, verify zero against another stable reference, and report separate errors for elevation difference and baseline.
units.failure: 基點本身下沉會讓全段看似正常；只量端點又會漏掉中間沉陷槽，兩種情況均可低估輪軌衝擊。 高差異常需先查基點，不能立刻推定路基局部下沉。~A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact. An unusual level difference requires a datum check before inferring local earthwork settlement.
units.misconception: 兩端高程相同就能證明兩點之間沒有差異沉陷~Equal endpoint elevations prove there is no differential settlement between them.
units.practice: 構造端點相同但中間下陷的剖面，與直線坡度模型比較；提出足以辨識沉陷槽寬度的測點間距與複測頻率。 再以本單元 drop 的對照值重算 gradient，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Construct a profile with equal endpoints and an intermediate trough, compare it with a straight-gradient model, and propose spacing and repeat intervals able to resolve the trough. Also recalculate gradient for the alternative drop value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 集水與排水容量~Catchment inflow and drainage capacity
units.title: 集水與排水容量~Catchment inflow and drainage capacity
units.mechanism: 短時逕流可先以降雨強度、集水面積和逕流係數估計，但設施排水還受入口阻塞、管線坡度與下游水位影響。鐵路集水範圍若只算軌道面，會漏掉坡面與站區流入。 合理化流量法假定雨強與集流條件相符，面積及逕流係數也須明確。它估算峰值流率而非完整洪水歷線；抽水或蓄水設計還需對時間積分和出口條件。 比較短時強降雨與長時降雨對集水估算的不同假設。~A first runoff estimate combines rainfall intensity, catchment area and runoff coefficient. Actual drainage also depends on inlet blockage, pipe slope and downstream water level. Counting only track surface can omit inflow from adjacent slopes and station areas. The rational estimate assumes rainfall intensity compatible with catchment response and explicit area and runoff coefficient. It gives a peak rate, not a complete hydrograph. Pumping or storage design additionally requires time integration and outlet conditions. Compare assumptions for short intense rainfall and longer rainfall in catchment estimates.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.1e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2；計算：flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.3213 m^3/s。敏感度：rain 單獨增加百分之十至 2.31e-05 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 0.35343 m^3/s。模型邊界：均勻降雨的合理化法概念；不含集流時間、水文頻率分析或蓄滯。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.1e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2; calculation: flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.3213 m^3/s. Sensitivity: rain, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 2.31e-05 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.35343 m^3/s. Model boundary: Uniform-rainfall rational-method concept; concentration time, frequency analysis and storage are excluded.
units.verify: 現地核對集水分界和入口標高，以雨量、液位與泵浦運轉紀錄檢查水量收支，分開分析正常排放和下游頂托。 核對雨量單位和有效集水邊界，量測泵浦出流與集水井水位變化，以體積守恆互證。~Check catchment boundaries and inlet elevations, use rainfall, water-level and pump logs for a balance, and distinguish normal outflow from downstream backwater. Verify rainfall units and catchment boundaries, measure pump outflow and sump-level change, and cross-check them through volume conservation.
units.failure: 垃圾堵塞入口會讓理論管徑容量無法發揮；下游水位上升又可能使出口排量下降，僅加大泵浦不能解決所有原因。 排水堵塞改變有效出流，不能只用較大泵浦銘牌值補償。~Blocked inlets can prevent nominal pipe capacity from being used, while rising tailwater reduces outflow; a larger pump does not resolve every cause. Blocked drainage changes effective outflow and cannot be compensated merely by a larger pump nameplate rating.
units.misconception: 排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位~A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater.
units.practice: 將部分入口視為堵塞，建立地表暫存與排出的水量表；比較增加入口和增加泵量對不同瓶頸的效果。 再以本單元 rain 的對照值重算 flow，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Block selected inlets in the scenario, tabulate surface storage and discharge, and compare additional inlets with additional pumping for different bottlenecks. Also recalculate flow for the alternative rain value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 坡度阻力與爬坡功率~Gradient resistance and climbing power
units.title: 坡度阻力與爬坡功率~Gradient resistance and climbing power
units.mechanism: 列車爬坡需提高重力位能，坡度小時沿線重力分量約等於重量乘坡度。功率還與速度相乘，因此相同牽引力下高速爬坡更耗功率；下坡則需處理持續制動能量而非僅一次停車。 坡度以升高量除以水平距離表示，百分比與小數不可混用。此項只表示重力位能增加的速率，總牽引功率還要加上加速、滾動、氣動及轉換損失。 把山區坡度帶來的持續功率與加速功率分別列出。~Climbing raises gravitational potential energy. For small gradients, the along-track gravity force is approximately weight times gradient. Multiplication by speed gives power, making faster climbing more demanding at equal force; descending requires continuous energy management rather than merely one stopping event. Gradient is rise divided by horizontal distance, so percentage and decimal representations must not be mixed. This term only gives the rate of gravitational potential-energy increase. Total traction demand also includes acceleration, rolling resistance, aerodynamics and conversion losses. List sustained gradient power separately from acceleration power on a hillside section.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mass=315000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s；計算：climbing=mass*9.81*gradient*v/1000=2472.12 kW。敏感度：mass 單獨增加百分之十至 346500 kg，其餘固定，結果為 2719.332 kW。模型邊界：小坡度且定速；不含空阻、輪阻、加速與傳動損失。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mass=315000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s; calculation: climbing=mass*9.81*gradient*v/1000=2472.12 kW. Sensitivity: mass, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 346500 kg, with all other inputs fixed, gives 2719.332 kW. Model boundary: Small gradient and constant speed; aerodynamic drag, rolling resistance, acceleration and drive losses are excluded.
units.verify: 以路線縱斷面和列車速度重建位能變化，對照受電功率積分；坡度資料與里程基準必須一致。 由高程剖面核對坡度，使用同一時間窗比對速度與牽引功率，另列非重力負載。~Reconstruct potential-energy change from the vertical alignment and train speed, compare it with integrated line power, and keep gradient and distance datums consistent. Check gradient from the elevation profile, compare speed and traction power over one time window, and list non-gravitational loads separately.
units.failure: 忽略長下坡持續熱負荷會把短時煞車能力誤當連續能力；坡度正負號錯誤則會把耗能段當成回收段。 功率不足時須分辨坡度阻力與黏著限制，不能只加大電流。~Ignoring sustained downhill heat confuses short-term braking capability with continuous rating; a gradient-sign error can mislabel an energy-consuming section as regenerative. When power is insufficient, distinguish gradient resistance from adhesion limits rather than only increasing current.
units.misconception: 長下坡只需通過一次緊急停車試驗就能驗證持續制動~One emergency stop test verifies continuous braking capability on a long descent.
units.practice: 用相同高差設計長緩坡與短陡坡，對比理想位能和峰值功率，指出兩者為何不能用同一項設備額定值評估。 再以本單元 mass 的對照值重算 climbing，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Design a long gentle and short steep climb with equal height gain, compare ideal energy and peak power, and explain why one equipment rating cannot evaluate both. Also recalculate climbing for the alternative mass value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 曲線超高與未平衡加速度~Cant and unbalanced acceleration
units.title: 曲線超高與未平衡加速度~Cant and unbalanced acceleration
units.mechanism: 曲線需求的向心加速度由重力沿軌道平面的分量與輪軌側向作用共同提供。超高平衡速度只對特定半徑和速度成立，慢車可能出現超高過剩；不能把增加超高當成所有車種都受益的措施。 殘餘加速度的正負表示側向作用方向，而不是安全與危險的二元判斷。半徑、軌距與高差必須使用一致長度單位，車體感受還會受到懸吊轉角影響。 比較曲線設計速度與降速通過情境的未平衡加速度。~On a curve, the component of gravity in the track plane and wheel-rail lateral forces together provide centripetal acceleration. Equilibrium cant applies to one radius and speed. A slower service can experience cant excess, so increasing cant does not improve every train condition. The sign of residual acceleration identifies its lateral direction, not a binary safe-unsafe outcome. Radius, gauge and rail-level difference require consistent length units. Carbody response is additionally affected by suspension rotation, which this geometric estimate does not resolve. Compare unbalanced acceleration at design speed and during a restricted-speed passage.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=63 m/s; R=4000 m; gauge=1.5 m; cant=0.12 m；計算：residual=v*v/R-9.81*cant/gauge=0.20745 m/s^2。敏感度：v 單獨增加百分之十至 69.3 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 0.4158225 m/s^2。模型邊界：小角度近似與剛性車體；未計懸吊側滾、動態輪重減載和規範允收值。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=63 m/s; R=4000 m; gauge=1.5 m; cant=0.12 m; calculation: residual=v*v/R-9.81*cant/gauge=0.20745 m/s^2. Sensitivity: v, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 69.3 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.4158225 m/s^2. Model boundary: Small-angle approximation and rigid body; suspension roll, dynamic wheel unloading and acceptance limits are excluded.
units.verify: 在相同半徑區段量測軌面高差與橫向加速度，扣除感測器安裝角度，並把車體讀值與軌道平面讀值分開記錄。 用實測半徑和高差重算平衡速度，保留感測器安裝角的校正值及量測不確定度。~Measure rail level difference and lateral acceleration on the same curve, remove sensor mounting angle, and distinguish carbody readings from track-plane readings. Recalculate equilibrium speed from measured radius and cant, retaining mounting-angle corrections and uncertainty for the acceleration sensor.
units.failure: 只依高速通過最佳化超高，可能讓慢車或停車承受反向側向力；感測器橫滾又會把重力投影混入振動訊號。 需核對高差符號與曲線方向，防止左右軌互換。~Cant optimised only for fast trains can impose reverse lateral loading on slow or stopped trains; sensor roll also mixes gravity into vibration measurements. Check cant sign against curve direction to prevent swapping the inner and outer rails.
units.misconception: 任何速度下增加超高都一定減少車內橫向加速度~Increasing cant always reduces lateral acceleration at every operating speed.
units.practice: 選兩種速度共同計算殘餘加速度，找出符號反轉位置，說明為何混合服務需要速度分布而非單一最高速度。 再以本單元 v 的對照值重算 residual，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Calculate residual acceleration for two speeds, locate its sign reversal, and explain why mixed services require a speed distribution rather than one maximum speed. Also recalculate residual for the alternative v value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 地震偵測提前量~Seismic detection lead time
units.title: 地震偵測提前量~Seismic detection lead time
units.mechanism: 地震警報的可用提前量來自較快波到達感測點與較慢強震波到達設施之間的差，再扣掉傳輸和判定延遲。距離太近時提前量可能為負，警報並不能讓列車瞬間停止。 此處以相同距離比較兩種波速，屬簡化幾何模型。實際感測站可能不在線路與震源之間；可用時間還包括資料品質檢查及保護命令發送，不能只比較波速。 用不同震源距離檢查預警可用提前量，不宣稱可預測地震。~Usable seismic lead time is the difference between faster-wave detection and slower damaging-wave arrival, less communication and decision delay. A nearby source may leave negative lead time. An alarm therefore cannot make a moving train stop instantaneously, even when the detection itself works correctly. The exercise compares two wave speeds over the same distance and therefore uses simplified geometry. A real sensor may not lie between the source and railway. Available time also includes data-quality checks and protection-command delivery, not only wave propagation. Check available lead time at different source distances without claiming earthquake prediction.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：distance=105000 m; vp=6000 m/s; vs=3500 m/s; latency=2 s；計算：lead=distance/vs-distance/vp-latency=10.5 s。敏感度：distance 單獨增加百分之十至 115500 m，其餘固定，結果為 11.75 s。模型邊界：共線源站幾何與固定波速；不預測震度或實際地震動。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: distance=105000 m; vp=6000 m/s; vs=3500 m/s; latency=2 s; calculation: lead=distance/vs-distance/vp-latency=10.5 s. Sensitivity: distance, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 115500 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 11.75 s. Model boundary: Collinear source-station geometry and constant wave speeds; neither intensity nor actual ground motion is predicted.
units.verify: 用歷史或合成波形重播整條訊號鏈，記錄偵測、判定、通訊及列車接收時間，量出漏警、誤警和延遲分布。 以完整訊號重播核對每個時間戳，將總延遲分解成判定、網路與列車端處理。~Replay historical or synthetic waveforms through the complete chain, log detection, decision, communication and train receipt times, and measure missed alarms, false alarms and latency distribution. Use full-chain signal replay to verify every timestamp and separate total delay into decision, network and train-side processing components.
units.failure: 只驗證感測器觸發而不驗證下游通訊，可能高估提前量；設備共用電源也可能讓兩條名義獨立通道同時失效。 感測成功不等於制動成功，須查列車收到命令後的動作。~Testing the sensor without downstream communication overestimates lead time; a shared power supply can also defeat nominally independent channels simultaneously. Successful detection is not successful braking; inspect the train response after command receipt.
units.misconception: 地震預警成功觸發就代表列車必能在強震前完全停下~A successfully triggered earthquake warning guarantees a complete stop before strong shaking.
units.practice: 將震源距離縮短並把通訊延遲加倍，計算剩餘提前量；與制動時間比較，提出只在模型範圍內成立的結論。 再以本單元 distance 的對照值重算 lead，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Shorten source distance and double communication delay, calculate remaining lead time, and compare it with braking time without extending the conclusion beyond the model. Also recalculate lead for the alternative distance value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 隧道壓力波傳遞~Tunnel pressure-wave travel
units.title: 隧道壓力波傳遞~Tunnel pressure-wave travel
units.mechanism: 列車鼻部入隧道產生壓縮擾動，壓力波以接近音速傳播而不是跟著列車速度前進。入口緩衝設計影響波形上升率，波到達出口的時間與車身到達時間屬不同問題，須分開建立量測觸發。 波傳時間由傳播距離除以聲速決定，與列車走完整段的時間不同。此式只預測到達時序而不預測波幅；洞口形狀、列車頭型和反射決定的壓力變化須用其他流動模型。 在連續隧道與洞口測點之間比較聲波傳播時間和列車通過時間，另列波幅問題。~A train nose entering a tunnel creates a compression disturbance whose propagation speed is close to acoustic speed rather than train speed. Entrance treatments affect the rise of the waveform. Wave arrival and train arrival are different events and require separate measurement triggers. Wave travel time is propagation distance divided by sound speed, not the time for the train to traverse the section. This expression predicts arrival timing, not amplitude. Portal geometry, train-nose shape and reflections require additional flow models to predict pressure changes. Compare acoustic travel time with train-passage time between tunnel and portal sensors, treating wave amplitude as a separate problem.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：length=2625 m; sound=340 m/s；計算：travel=length/sound=7.720588 s。敏感度：length 單獨增加百分之十至 2887.5 m，其餘固定，結果為 8.492647 s。模型邊界：一維線性聲學且音速均勻；不預測波幅、微壓波峰值或反射耗散。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: length=2625 m; sound=340 m/s; calculation: travel=length/sound=7.720588 s. Sensitivity: length, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 2887.5 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 8.492647 s. Model boundary: One-dimensional linear acoustics with uniform sound speed; amplitude, micro-pressure-wave peaks and reflection losses are not predicted.
units.verify: 在入口與出口配置同步壓力計，用互相關估計傳遞時間，並用溫度估算音速；列車里程觸發另存一條通道。 在洞口與洞內配置同步壓力測點，對照列車頭部通過時刻，分辨首波與後續反射。~Use synchronised pressure sensors at both portals, estimate travel time by cross-correlation and sound speed from temperature, and retain train-position triggering separately. Synchronise pressure sensors at the portal and inside the tunnel with nose-passage time, distinguishing the first wave from later reflections.
units.failure: 時間戳誤差會被誤認為波速變化；長隧道的反射波與多車事件也可能讓互相關找到錯誤的峰。 單點峰值不足以判別首波，須檢查測點間傳遞時差。~Timestamp error can imitate a wave-speed change, while reflected waves and multiple train events can make cross-correlation select the wrong peak. A single peak cannot identify the first wave; inspect propagation delay between sensors.
units.misconception: 隧道壓力波必定與列車以相同速度到達出口~A tunnel pressure wave necessarily reaches the portal at the same speed as the train.
units.practice: 比較壓力波與列車兩種到達時間，加入一次端部反射畫出事件圖，說明單一延遲量無法判斷出口微壓波是否超標。 再以本單元 length 的對照值重算 travel，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare wave and train arrival times, add one end reflection to the event diagram, and explain why travel time alone cannot establish compliance of portal micro-pressure waves. Also recalculate travel for the alternative length value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕~Transfer walking and connection margin
units.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕~Transfer walking and connection margin
units.mechanism: 轉乘能否銜接取決於實際可用時間扣除下車、步行、垂直動線與候車需求。最短路徑不一定最快，因為樓梯、閘門與人流交會造成等待；無障礙路徑需要獨立列出而非套用同一速度。 距離除速度只表示行走或移動時間，等待列車、排隊和辨識路徑應另列。使用單一平均速度會掩蓋行李、行動能力和雙向干擾，應以分段分群資料檢查。 把接駁列車步行、等待和搭乘分成可核對的旅程段。~A connection depends on available time after alighting, walking, vertical circulation and boarding needs. The shortest route is not always fastest because stairs, gates and crossing streams cause waiting. Accessible routes need their own timing rather than an assumed common walking speed. Distance divided by speed represents movement only; train waiting, queueing and wayfinding need separate terms. One mean speed hides baggage, mobility differences and opposing flow. Check the result with segmented measurements for relevant passenger groups. Split feeder walking, waiting and riding into independently verifiable journey stages.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：available=300 s; distance=189 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s；計算：margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=66 s。敏感度：distance 單獨增加百分之十至 207.9 m，其餘固定，結果為 47.1 s。模型邊界：固定步速與額外時間；不包含動態排隊或旅客個別差異分布。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: available=300 s; distance=189 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s; calculation: margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=66 s. Sensitivity: distance, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 207.9 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 47.1 s. Model boundary: Fixed walking speed and additional time; dynamic queues and individual variability distributions are excluded.
units.verify: 以匿名實測旅程時間分位數比較路徑，記錄電梯等待及閘門排隊，檢查轉乘圖的距離是否包含所有垂直動線。 在路徑起終點對時，逐段記錄水平、垂直與等待時間，核對是否漏計驗票或排隊。~Compare route-time quantiles from anonymous observations, record lift and gate waits, and check that route distances include every vertical circulation segment. Synchronise route endpoints, record horizontal movement, vertical movement and waiting separately, and check for omitted gate processing or queues.
units.failure: 只用最快步行者校準會低估多數人的轉乘時間；電梯停機又可能使唯一無障礙路徑失去連續性。 旅客走錯路會改變實際距離，需比較引導前後的路徑。~Calibrating to the fastest walkers understates many passengers’ transfer time; a failed lift can also break the only continuous accessible route. Wrong turns change actual distance; compare observed routes before and after guidance changes.
units.misconception: 轉乘路線距離最短就一定適合所有旅客最快銜接~The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection.
units.practice: 比較一般與無障礙兩條路徑的餘裕，加入一台電梯停機情境，說明時刻表調整與空間導引分別能改善哪一段。 再以本單元 distance 的對照值重算 margin，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare connection margins for ordinary and accessible routes, add one unavailable lift, and distinguish improvements from timetable changes versus spatial guidance. Also recalculate margin for the alternative distance value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 到站變異與平均等候~Arrival variability and mean waiting
units.title: 到站變異與平均等候~Arrival variability and mean waiting
units.mechanism: 當旅客隨機到站且不受容量限制時，平均等待與班距平方的期望值有關，長班距被更多旅客遇到。兩組平均班距相同的服務仍可能有不同等待時間，因此準點與均勻性具有獨立價值。 隨機到站旅客更容易遇到較長班距，因為長區間占較多時間，因此平均等候與班距變異數有關。公式假定旅客到達獨立於班表且每班可上車，不能表示服務櫃台或容量不足的隊列。 比較接駁班距波動造成的隨機等候，批次到達另做事件模擬。~With random passenger arrivals and no capacity constraint, mean waiting depends on the expected squared headway. More passengers encounter longer gaps. Services with identical mean headway can therefore have different waiting times, giving regularity a value separate from the average frequency. Random arrivals encounter longer headways more often because those intervals occupy more time. Mean waiting therefore depends on headway variance. The formula assumes arrivals independent of the timetable and successful boarding on every train; it does not model counters or capacity-constrained queues. Compare random waiting from feeder-headway variability and separately simulate batch arrivals.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mean=189 s; sd=60 s；計算：wait=(mean**2+sd**2)/(2*mean)=104.0238 s。敏感度：mean 單獨增加百分之十至 207.9 s，其餘固定，結果為 112.608 s。模型邊界：獨立隨機旅客到達、穩態班距且皆可登車；不含時刻表配合到站。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mean=189 s; sd=60 s; calculation: wait=(mean**2+sd**2)/(2*mean)=104.0238 s. Sensitivity: mean, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 207.9 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 112.608 s. Model boundary: Random independent passenger arrivals, stationary headways and no denied boarding; timetable-aware arrivals are excluded.
units.verify: 從連續到站紀錄計算班距平均與變異數，再用匿名旅客到站時刻重播等待，檢查是否存在容量不足或非隨機到站。 從逐列到站時間重建班距平均與標準差，將旅客隨機到達事件重播，核對等候樣本平均。~Calculate headway mean and variance from consecutive arrivals, replay waiting with anonymous passenger arrival times, and check for capacity limits or nonrandom arrivals. Reconstruct mean and standard deviation from successive train arrivals, replay random passenger arrivals, and compare the sampled mean waiting time.
units.failure: 只報平均班距會低估不規則服務的等待；旅客配合時刻表到站時又不能直接套用隨機到站公式。 若滿載造成無法上車，需額外追蹤留下隊列而不能沿用公式。~Reporting only mean headway understates waiting under irregular service, while timetable-aware arrivals invalidate the random-arrival formula. When full trains prevent boarding, track the remaining queue separately instead of reusing this formula.
units.misconception: 兩組平均班距相同就一定有相同平均等候時間~Two services with equal mean headway necessarily have equal mean passenger waiting time.
units.practice: 保持平均班距不變，把標準差減半後重算等待，並用一組確定性到站時間說明公式假設何時失效。 再以本單元 mean 的對照值重算 wait，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Hold mean headway fixed and halve its standard deviation, recalculate waiting, then use deterministic arrivals to show when the formula assumptions fail. Also recalculate wait for the alternative mean value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 周轉時間與車隊需求~Round-trip time and fleet size
units.title: 周轉時間與車隊需求~Round-trip time and fleet size
units.mechanism: 維持固定班距所需列車數取決於完整周轉時間除班距並向上取整，周轉包含兩端折返與停站。備用車和維修車需另列；只用單程行車時間會把車隊需求低估接近一半。 循環時間除以班距後必須向上取整，半列車不能提供完整班次。此數量是投入循環的最低值，維修備用、延誤緩衝與不同分支運轉仍需額外配置。 把接駁與高速列車班距分開排程，檢查整體銜接需求。~Fleet requirement for fixed headway is round-trip cycle time divided by headway, rounded upward. The cycle includes terminal turnbacks and stops. Spares and maintenance vehicles are additional; using only one-way running time can underestimate the requirement by nearly half. Divide cycle time by headway and round upward because a fraction of a train cannot provide a full departure. This is the minimum circulating requirement; maintenance spares, delay buffers and branch-specific operation need additional allocation. Schedule feeder and high-speed headways separately and inspect connection requirements.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：cycle=5670 s; headway=180 s；計算：fleet=ceil(cycle/headway)=32 trains。敏感度：cycle 單獨增加百分之十至 6237 s，其餘固定，結果為 35 trains。模型邊界：固定周轉與班距、無延誤；不含備用率和維修排程。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: cycle=5670 s; headway=180 s; calculation: fleet=ceil(cycle/headway)=32 trains. Sensitivity: cycle, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 6237 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 35 trains. Model boundary: Fixed cycle and headway without delays; reserve ratio and maintenance scheduling are excluded.
units.verify: 逐列串接實際到發時間檢查周轉，將折返與等待分開，並對尖峰班距需求與可出車數建立同一時點的清單。 核對往返與折返時間使用同一單位，以逐列時刻表重播，檢查每次發車是否有車可用。~Join actual arrival and departure logs by train, separate turnback from waiting, and compare peak headway requirements with trains available at the same time. Verify consistent units for round-trip and turnaround times, replay a train-by-train timetable, and check vehicle availability at every departure.
units.failure: 列車數足夠仍可能因機廠出入路徑受限而無法準時上線；忽略維修週期則會讓紙上車隊數不可持續。 循環時間稍增可能跨過整數門檻，不能只比較百分比。~Sufficient fleet count may still fail when depot access restricts insertion; ignoring maintenance cycles makes the paper fleet unsustainable. A small cycle-time increase can cross an integer fleet threshold; percentages alone are insufficient.
units.misconception: 車隊需求可以只用單程時間除以班距決定~Fleet requirement can be determined using one-way time divided by headway alone.
units.practice: 增加一端折返時間後重算車隊，檢查向上取整造成的跳變，再提出維修備用與臨時故障應如何另列。 再以本單元 cycle 的對照值重算 fleet，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Increase one terminal turnback time, recalculate fleet and examine rounding jumps, then explain separate allowances for maintenance reserve and unexpected failures. Also recalculate fleet for the alternative cycle value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

facts: 已查證背景：2023 年，雅萬高速鐵路於十月舉行啟用並開始付費服務。~Verified background: 2023, Jakarta–Bandung high-speed rail was inaugurated and began paid service in October.
教學假設，單元 1：L=26.25 m，計算 deflection=1.103997 mm；非實測性能。~Teaching assumption, unit 1: L=26.25 m, calculated deflection=1.103997 mm; not measured performance.
教學假設，單元 2：drop=0.0126 m，計算 gradient=0.63 mm/m；非實測性能。~Teaching assumption, unit 2: drop=0.0126 m, calculated gradient=0.63 mm/m; not measured performance.
教學假設，單元 3：rain=2.1e-05 m/s，計算 flow=0.3213 m^3/s；非實測性能。~Teaching assumption, unit 3: rain=2.1e-05 m/s, calculated flow=0.3213 m^3/s; not measured performance.
教學假設，單元 4：mass=315000 kg，計算 climbing=2472.12 kW；非實測性能。~Teaching assumption, unit 4: mass=315000 kg, calculated climbing=2472.12 kW; not measured performance.
教學假設，單元 5：v=63 m/s，計算 residual=0.20745 m/s^2；非實測性能。~Teaching assumption, unit 5: v=63 m/s, calculated residual=0.20745 m/s^2; not measured performance.
